149447447.title: File:Standard Oil Company GPM Lawton Oklahoma.jpg

ImageDescription.value: Standard Oil Company was established in 1870 by John D. Rockefeller. In 1880s, Standard Oil delivered petroluem by-products such as kerosene for illuminating businesses, homes, and fueling kerosene kitchens.

Standard Oil shows Uncle Sam the new blank page of Standard Oil Records, covering up the previous page stained with Kansas Holdup, Rebates, and Conspiracy. Several more locked volumes rest under his desk. Uncle Sam holds the candle of Investigation. The caption reads "Standard Oil - You see, we are just turning over a new leaf." Standard Oil was the subject of a government investigation into their rate fixing, as well as other schemes.

John D. Rockefeller listens to the ground as the Standard Oil Report comes out of Congress. The caption reads 'To some people it sounds like an earthquake'. President Roosevelt was sending a message to Congress, after an investigation, of the many crimes committed by Standard Oil in its collusion with Railroad companies.
